Same scored set, reached by different routes. This is what makes the comparison below legitimate.

reading: The one real construction difference. Whether an international game should have its home term removed is a modelling choice that needs a pre-registered rule, not a preference; it is raised as a question for the owner rather than settled by either build.

quantity: MAE gain over the naive reference line, pooled
reading: Two independently written pipelines land within 0.06 points of each other. That convergence is stronger evidence than either number alone, and both are far below the 1.74 points the published 89-game corpus shows.
